description:
Incorporated in 2000, Matrimony.com Ltd provides matchmaking services and marriage services [1]

Key Points:
Business Overview: [1] [2] [3] a) Matrimony.com is the largest matchmaking service provider in India. b) The company offers diversified online matchmaking services to both online and offline to cater to the unique requirements of Indian-origin consumers like regional, community, and also tailor made services for the elite. c) It also provides an asset-light vendor platform for venue bookings, catering, decorations, etc. d) Currently, it has a Paid subscription the base of 1 Mn profiles in FY25 e) It differentiates itself from other players in India by following a micro-market strategy, offering a range of targeted and customized products and services that are tailored to meet the requirements of customers
